tabs.title: Overview
paragraphs: Woodgrove Bank runs its core banking app on Azure VMs (virtual machines) in the Southeast Asia region. Regulators require a tested disaster recovery plan and protected backups.

tabs.title: Existing environment
paragraphs: - The app has three VMs: vm-db (database), vm-app (middleware), and vm-web (web front end).
- The Recovery Services vault rsv-sea in Southeast Asia uses geo-redundant storage and backs up the three VMs every day.
- Auditors from the partner company Fabrikam use accounts in the fabrikam.com tenant.

tabs.title: Requirements
paragraphs: - The three VMs must be replicated to East Asia. During a failover, vm-db must start first, then vm-app, then vm-web.
- Disaster recovery must be tested every quarter without any impact on production.
- A single deleted file on vm-app must be recoverable without restoring the whole VM.
- Only the security team may invite the Fabrikam auditors as guests. Guests must not be able to browse the list of users and groups.
- Attackers who gain administrator access must not be able to delete backups or shorten their retention.

questions.prompt: Where should you create the Recovery Services vault for the replication?
options: In a Backup vault in Southeast Asia
questions.explanation: Vault Site Recovery dibuat di region mana pun kecuali region sumber, jadi bukan Southeast Asia dan bukan rsv-sea. Backup vault tidak dipakai Site Recovery.

questions.prompt: Which two should you use to meet the disaster recovery requirements? Choose two.
options: Cross Region Restore from rsv-sea every quarter
A recovery plan with the groups vm-db, then vm-app, then vm-web
A failover followed by commit every quarter
A test failover into a non-production virtual network
questions.explanation: Recovery plan mengatur urutan start saat failover, dan test failover menguji tanpa mengganggu produksi. Failover plus commit adalah failover sungguhan, dan Cross Region Restore memulihkan backup, bukan replikasi.

questions.prompt: How should you recover the deleted file on vm-app?
options: Use File Recovery from the VM (virtual machine) backup
Fail over vm-app with Site Recovery
questions.explanation: File Recovery me-mount volume recovery point sehingga satu file bisa disalin tanpa me-restore VM (virtual machine).

questions.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
questions.scenario: You configure the external collaboration settings of the Woodgrove tenant.

statements.text: If guest invitations are limited to specific admin roles and the security team has the Guest Inviter role, the security team can invite guests and regular members cannot.
The default guest user access level prevents guests from browsing the list of users and groups.
The auditors sign in with passwords stored in the Woodgrove tenant.

questions.explanation: Hanya admin tertentu, termasuk Guest Inviter, yang bisa mengundang. Level default limited access memblokir guest dari daftar user dan group. Akun guest B2B (business-to-business) diautentikasi oleh penyedia identitas milik guest.

questions.prompt: What should you configure on rsv-sea to protect the backups?
options: A Backup Reader role for the administrators
questions.explanation: Immutable vault memblokir penghapusan data backup dan pengurangan retensi, dan kuncinya membuat pengaturan itu tidak bisa dibatalkan.
